cats.TRIG: The SEQ button: the step's own settings (note, length, velocity, resets), trig conditions and ratchets, and the trig-jump / slice page. Setup: swing.
cats.SRC: The SEL button: the track's sound source - pitch, loop region, sample slot, machine and warp-mode controls over the waveform. Setup: machine, warp mode, loop division, polyphony.
cats.FILT: The EDIT button: the track's filter, its envelope and its stereo / mid-side spread. Setup: filter machine, filter envelope mode, mix mode.
cats.AMP: The ENV button: the amp envelope, volume, pan and the two send levels. Setup: envelope mode and range, portamento, slice hold.
cats.FX: The FX button: the track's insert effect (or, with S1 / S2 / MST selected, that bus's effect) and the send levels. Setup: the FX machine and the send tap.
cats.MOD: The LFO button: two LFOs, the mod envelope, velocity modulation and the four macros with their depth matrices. No setup.
cats.MST: The MST upper key: the mixer, the master settings (tempo, swing, global length, playhead return) and the A / B scene crossfader. Setup: return mode, tempo, global BPM, project name.
cats.FILE: The SAVE button: the sample browser and the slot's file settings, and RAZOR, the slice editor for the track's sample.
cats.PAT: The ARP button: the track's pattern length and step rate, the global length and how pattern changes engage. Setup: change mode, global length.

pages.TRIG/TRIG: The basic step settings: note pitch, note length and velocity, and the three reset flags (envelope, LFO, filter). Hold a step to lock any of them on that step.
pages.TRIG/COND: Whether and how often a step fires: chance, trig condition (A:B cycles, FILL, PRE, 1ST ...) and ratchet repeats.
pages.TRIG/PLAYHEAD: How a trig engages the loop region: trig jump and trig release. On slice machines this page is SLICE instead: slice number, play mode, ratchet, reverse.
pages.TRIG/SETUP: The global swing amount, shared by every track.
pages.SRC/LOOP: The main view: the track's waveform with pitch, loop start / end and sample slot (slice machines: play mode, slice, slice count, choke, slice mute). Empty for NEIGH and INPUT, which show their routing / input meters.
pages.SRC/MACHINE: The machine's own controls: loop reverse, crossfade and trig release for loop machines; slice, play mode, reverse, ratchet, clock sync and rate for slice machines.
pages.SRC/WARP: The warp mode's controls (each mode shows its own: grains, stretch, harmonies, wavetable ...) plus RATE, over the waveform. Empty for NEIGH and INPUT.
pages.SRC/RANGE: The Range: a narrower window inside the sample's trim that the loop points, loop keys and slices work within.
pages.SRC/SETUP: The track's machine, warp mode (changes only while stopped), loop-key division and trig polyphony.
pages.FILT/FILTER: The filter machine's controls (cutoff, resonance and its own third / fourth knob) and the filter envelope depth, over the filter curve.
pages.FILT/ENV: The filter envelope's times (ADSR or AHR, per the setup) and its depth onto the cutoff.
pages.FILT/MIX: How the filter treats the two channels: the stereo / mid-side cutoff spread (BAL) and the dry / wet mix (COMB and FORMNT only).
pages.FILT/SETUP: The filter machine, the filter envelope mode and the stereo / mid-side mix mode. Machine and mix mode change only while stopped.
pages.AMP/ENV: The amp envelope (ADSR or AHR), track volume, pan and the S1 / S2 send levels, over the envelope's shape.
pages.AMP/SETUP: Amp envelope mode, the time range of every envelope, portamento (legato), and how long slice notes last.
pages.FX/FX: The track's insert effect: the chosen FX machine's knobs over a picture of it (delay taps, reverb tail, compressor curve with meters ...). Empty for NONE.
pages.FX/SENDS: How much of the track goes to the S1 and S2 send buses, and where it is tapped (before or after the insert).
pages.FX/SETUP: Choose the insert FX machine (any time, with a short fade) and the send tap point.
pages.MOD/LFO 1: LFO 1: destination, waveform, synced speed, bipolar depth and trigger mode. The bar shows the live value at the destination.
pages.MOD/LFO 2: LFO 2: destination, waveform, synced speed, bipolar depth and trigger mode. The bar shows the live value at the destination.
pages.MOD/ENV: The mod envelope (ADSR), its destination and depth. It retriggers on steps whose ERST is on, for the note's length.
pages.MOD/VELOCITY: Velocity as a mod source: where it goes and how much. Velocity comes from slice trigs only.
pages.MOD/MACROS: The four macro values M1-M4 at a glance. Each macro moves pitch, cutoff, resonance, amp and pan by its own depths.
pages.MOD/MACRO 1: Macro 1: its value and how far it moves pitch, cutoff, resonance, amp and pan.
pages.MOD/MACRO 2: Macro 2: its value and how far it moves pitch, cutoff, resonance, amp and pan.
pages.MOD/MACRO 3: Macro 3: its value and how far it moves pitch, cutoff, resonance, amp and pan.
pages.MOD/MACRO 4: Macro 4: its value and how far it moves pitch, cutoff, resonance, amp and pan.
pages.MST/TRACK MIX: The mixer: all six tracks' levels and the S1 / S2 returns at a glance; the knobs set the selected track's volume, pan and mute, and the tempo.
pages.MST/MASTER: Project timing: tempo, swing, global pattern length and what the playhead does when the loop keys are let go.
pages.MST/SCENE: The A / B scene crossfader: the fader, its glide positions and the params that morph. The lower keys are the scene row here.
pages.MST/SETUP: Playhead return mode, tempo, global BPM (one tempo for every pattern) and the project's name.
pages.FILE/SAMPLE: The sample browser (SELECT moves the cursor, SAVE loads into the track's slot) and the slot's BPM, length in steps, gain, slot number and trim.
pages.FILE/RAZOR: The razor slice editor for the track's sample: move each slice's start / end with a snap mode, zoom, set its play mode, choke group, pitch and the transient sensitivity. OCT+ splits, OCT- deletes.
pages.PAT/PATTERN: The pattern grid with the track's pattern length and step rate, the global length and the pattern change mode.
pages.PAT/SETUP: How a newly picked pattern engages (quantize mode) and the global length it waits for.
pages.bus:S1: Send bus 1's effect: the knobs of the FX machine on the S1 return (global, not p-lockable; morphs with the scenes).
pages.bus:S1/SETUP: Choose the FX machine on the S1 return. NONE returns nothing.
pages.bus:S2: Send bus 2's effect: the knobs of the FX machine on the S2 return (global, not p-lockable; morphs with the scenes).
pages.bus:S2/SETUP: Choose the FX machine on the S2 return. NONE returns nothing.
pages.bus:MST: The master insert: the knobs of the FX machine on the final mix, send returns included (global, not p-lockable).
pages.bus:MST/SETUP: Choose the FX machine on the master insert. NONE passes the mix through clean.
pages.bus:MST/SRC: With the master bus selected, SRC shows the mixer: track levels and the returns, with the selected track's volume, pan, mute and the tempo.
pages.F3: The timing pop-up (OCT- + OCT+, or PLAY held): tempo on SELECT, swing on ALGORITHM, the track's pattern length and rate, global length and change mode; the lower keys pick and loop the step pages.

machine.LOOP: Plays the loop region continuously; each trig restarts it. Loop keys scrub and lock the region live.
machine.TRIG: The loop engine, but silent except while a triggered step's note lasts; each step can lock its own region.
machine.SLICE: Cuts the region into equal slices (CNT, up to 32) played by trigs and pads. One voice at a time.
machine.RAZOR: Plays the slices of the razor table, each with its own start / end (FILE > RAZOR). One voice at a time.
machine.S.POLY: SLICE with polyphony: up to 8 voices per track, 24 in all (the oldest is stolen).
machine.R.POLY: RAZOR with polyphony: up to 8 voices per track, 24 in all.
machine.NEIGH: No sample: the source is the whole output of the track to the left (T2-T6), heard only through this track's filter, insert, amp and pan.
machine.INPUT: The host's live audio input is the source, through the track's filter, insert, amp and sends; plays whether the transport runs or not.

warp.TAPE: Plays at the sample's own speed, like a tape deck: speeding up raises the pitch.
warp.VARI: Tempo varispeed: fits the region to its step length at the current tempo, so it always lands on the loop boundary. P/T has no effect here.
warp.DOMINO: A step-synced slicer: the region is cut into SLCS slices, one played every SLEN steps, each with its own envelope and loop mode.
warp.GRAIN: Granular: overlapping grains read around a moving emitter; size, density, spread and grain speed shape the texture, pitch stays independent.
warp.OLA: Random overlap-add: shuffled grains wander around the playhead; CHAOS blends in the wet grains and widens the wander.
warp.PITCH: Pitch correct: a tempo-fitted read through a pitch shifter, so timing and pitch are set separately (a robotic, formant-y character).
warp.HARM: Harmonizer: the dry loop plus up to three pitch-shifted copies at IN1-IN3 semitones (0 = that voice off).
warp.WTBL: Wavetable: the loop region becomes a bank of single cycles played by an oscillator (pitch from P/T and the keys, base C3), scanned by MORF and its LFO.
warp.FREEZE: Spectral freeze: FRZE captures and holds the spectrum at the playhead as a drone; BLUR smears it.
warp.FORMNT: Formant: shifts the spectral envelope (FORM, in semitones) and can freeze it too.
warp.GSTR: GStretch: pitch-held time stretch; STRCH sets the read speed (1 = real time), a pitch shifter restores the pitch.
warp.GSTR2: GStretch 2: as GSTR, but tempo-synced: the region passes once per loop, STRCH and RATE deviate from that.
warp.CHOP: Chopped (Digitakt-style): a clock ramp sweeps the region and a grain fires every SLEN steps at natural pitch, so the loop stretches to any tempo without changing pitch.

filter.CLASSC: Classic multimode filter: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or notch (TYPE), with cutoff, resonance and drive.
filter.MORPH: Morphing filter: MRPH sweeps continuously from low-pass through notch to high-pass.
filter.LADDER: Moog-style ladder low-pass; rings hard at high resonance but cannot run away.
filter.COMB: Tuned feedback comb: TUNE sets its pitch, FB the resonance, DAMP darkens each echo, MIX blends dry / wet.
filter.FORMNT: Vowel filter bank: VOWL morphs A-E-I-O-U, CUT transposes the formants, RES sharpens them, MIX blends dry / wet.
filter.SVF: State-variable multimode filter (LP / HP / BP / notch) with smoother type changes than CLASSC.

fenv.ADSR: Attack, decay, sustain, release: the filter envelope follows the note length, sustaining until the note ends.
fenv.AHR: Attack, hold, release: the filter envelope ignores the note length; HOLD at its top holds forever.

env.ADSR: Attack, decay, sustain, release: the sound sustains while the step's note lasts (LEN), then releases.
env.AHR: Attack, hold, release: ignores the note length; HOLD at its top (INF) keeps the sound on until the next trig.

fx.NONE: No effect: a clean pass-through on an insert or the master; on a send bus nothing is returned.
fx.DELAY: Clean digital tempo-synced delay with a low-pass in the feedback.
fx.COMP: Compressor with real dB / ms readouts and in / gain-reduction meters; MIX below full gives parallel compression.
fx.DESTRY: Destroy: a distortion chain (warble, overdrive, fold, saturation, bitcrush, sample-rate reduction, tone, level). Always fully wet.
fx.ECHO: Coloured stereo echo: tempo-synced time, right-tap offset, stereo or ping-pong, tone in the loop and wobble.
fx.B.HOLE: Blackhole: a huge modulated reverb; GRAV at maximum freezes the tail.
fx.FLANGR: Flanger: a swept short delay with bipolar feedback.
fx.PHASER: Phaser: 1 to 8 swept all-pass stages with feedback.
fx.DJ EQ: Three-band DJ isolator EQ with kills and adjustable crossovers. Always wet.
fx.DUCK: Ducker: dips this slot whenever the dry program plays (best on a send). Always wet.
fx.T.ECHO: Tape echo: tempo-synced delay with wow, flutter and saturation in the loop.
fx.CASSET: Cassette: wow, flutter, hiss, crackle, dropouts and a band-limited tone.
fx.MOTION: Stereo motion: width, plus synced tremolo and autopan. Always wet.
fx.RINGS: Ring modulator or frequency shifter (MODE), with feedback.
fx.LIMIT: Brickwall limiter: push GAIN into the ceiling. Always wet.

mute.name: Mute
mute.desc: Silences the track (its sends still feed S1 / S2). Saved with the pattern; also a held track key.

machine.name: Machine
machine.desc: What the track plays: LOOP, TRIG, SLICE, RAZOR, S.POLY, R.POLY, NEIGH (the left track) or INPUT (the live input). A setting, not p-lockable.

pitch.name: Pitch
pitch.desc: Transposes the track, -24 to +24 semitones; on TRIG it is the step's note. P-lockable. In TAPE it is speed too; VARI ignores it.

sample_slot.name: Sample slot
sample_slot.desc: Which of the 16 pool slots the track plays. Tracks sharing a slot share its sample and its file settings.

loop_start.name: Loop start
loop_start.desc: Where the loop region starts, 0 to 128 across the Range. P-lockable (a step can play its own region).

loop_end.name: Loop end
loop_end.desc: Where the loop region ends, 0 to 128 across the Range. P-lockable (a step can play its own region).

range_start.name: Range start
range_start.desc: The start of the Range, the window inside the sample's trim that loop points, loop keys and slices map onto (0 to 128). P-lockable.

range_end.name: Range end
range_end.desc: The end of the Range, the window inside the sample's trim that loop points, loop keys and slices map onto (0 to 128). P-lockable.

loop_reverse.name: Loop reverse
loop_reverse.desc: Plays the loop region backwards. In DOMINO it reverses the slice order. P-lockable.

xfade.name: Loop crossfade
xfade.desc: Crossfade time at the loop seam and on region jumps, 0 to 250 ms; in WTBL, the fade when the region moves. Longer = smoother, softer edges.

mode.name: Warp mode
mode.desc: How a loop machine reads its region: TAPE, VARI, DOMINO, GRAIN, OLA, PITCH, HARM, WTBL, FREEZE, FORMNT, GSTR, GSTR2 or CHOP. Changes only while stopped.

mode_macro.name: Warp macro
mode_macro.desc: The warp mode's own amount, 0 to 100%: CHAOS in OLA, SMEAR in PITCH (wider window), harmony MIX in HARM, MORF (wavetable scan) in WTBL.

chop_steps.name: Domino slices
chop_steps.desc: DOMINO: how many equal slices the region is cut into, 1 to 64.

chop_slice_len.name: Slice length
chop_slice_len.desc: DOMINO and CHOP: steps per slice / grain, 0.05 to 32 (SHIFT snaps to whole steps). 1 = a new slice every step.

chop_loop_mode.name: Slice loop mode
chop_loop_mode.desc: DOMINO: what each slice does inside its slot - CHOP (stop), LOOP, PONG or RUN (run on past the slice), each also reversed (R). Not on CHOP, which has no slice loop (nor has the original's CHOPPED).

chop_attack.name: Slice attack
chop_attack.desc: DOMINO and CHOP: fade-in of each slice / grain, 0.1 to 200 ms.

chop_hold.name: Slice gate
chop_hold.desc: DOMINO and CHOP: how much of each slot the slice sounds, 0 to 100%. Lower = rhythmic gating, full = smooth.

chop_release.name: Slice release
chop_release.desc: DOMINO and CHOP: fade-out of each slice / grain, 0.1 to 200 ms.

grain_size.name: Grain size
grain_size.desc: GRAIN: the length of each grain, 2 to 500 ms. In GSTR / GSTR2 (PWIN): the pitch shifter's window; bigger = smoother pitch, more smear.

grain_density.name: Grain density
grain_density.desc: GRAIN: how many grains overlap, 1 to 64. In GSTR / GSTR2 (SMTH): smoothing; higher = less metallic, a little softer.

grain_jitter.name: Grain spread
grain_jitter.desc: GRAIN: random scatter of where grains start around the emitter, none to wide. 0 = all from the same point.

grain_speed.name: Grain speed
grain_speed.desc: GRAIN: how fast the emitter moves through the region, 0 (frozen) to 4x. In GSTR / GSTR2 (STRCH): the stretch, 1/16x to 4x, 1 = real time.

grain_speed_rand.name: Grain speed random
grain_speed_rand.desc: GRAIN: random variation of each grain's playback speed, 0 to 100%.

grain_direction.name: Grain direction
grain_direction.desc: GRAIN: the share of grains that play forwards, 0 to 100%. 100% = all forward, 0% = all backward.

warp_rate.name: Warp rate
warp_rate.desc: Tempo-synced speed multiplier for the warp mode's read, 1/16x to 8x; 1 = in time. P-lockable.

slice_count.name: Slice count
slice_count.desc: SLICE / S.POLY: how many equal slices the region is cut into, 1 to 32.

slice_index.name: Slice
slice_index.desc: Which slice the track or step plays, 1 to 32. P-lockable per step.

slice_play_mode.name: Slice play mode
slice_play_mode.desc: 1SHOT (to the end), HOLD (while the note lasts), LOOP, CONT (on past the slice), PONG (back and forth) or CLOOP (continue, looping). P-lockable.

slice_ratchet.name: Slice ratchet
slice_ratchet.desc: Repeats the slice 1 to 4 times within the step (multiplies the trig ratchet). P-lockable.

slice_sync.name: Slice clock sync
slice_sync.desc: ON: slice speed follows the clock (tempo-fitting warp modes stretch slices to the tempo). OFF: slice RATE sets the speed.

slice_rate.name: Slice rate
slice_rate.desc: Slice playback speed when SYNC is off, 1/8x to 8x. P-lockable.

slice_hold_to_step.name: Slice hold to step
slice_hold_to_step.desc: ON: a slice note lasts the step's note length (LEN). OFF: it lasts the HOLD time instead.

slice_hold.name: Slice hold time
slice_hold.desc: How long a slice note lasts when SHLD is off, 0 to 4 seconds.

pattern_steps.name: Pattern length
pattern_steps.desc: The track's pattern length, 1 to 256 steps. Tracks can differ (polymeter).

trig_jump.name: Trig jump
trig_jump.desc: ON: a trig snaps the playhead to its region's start. OFF: the playhead keeps its position, jumping only if it falls outside the region. P-lockable.

trig_release.name: Trig release
trig_release.desc: When a step's region lock ends: RETURN (back in sync, where the loop would be), BOOMR (plays back out in reverse) or RESET (from the start). P-lockable.

trig_chance.name: Trig chance
trig_chance.desc: The probability a step fires, 0 to 100%. P-lockable per step.

trig_condition.name: Trig condition
trig_condition.desc: When a step fires: -- (always), A:B (the A-th of every B passes), FILL / !FILL, PRE / !PRE (previous conditional passed), NEI / !NEI, 1ST (first pass only).

trig_ratchet.name: Trig ratchet
trig_ratchet.desc: Repeats the step 1 to 8 times, evenly spread over the step. P-lockable.

env_reset.name: Envelope reset
env_reset.desc: ON: the step retriggers the mod envelope. With ERST, LRST and FRST all off the step is a ghost trig (no new note). P-lockable.

lfo_reset.name: LFO reset
lfo_reset.desc: ON: the step restarts the LFOs that are in TRIG, ONE or HOLD mode. P-lockable.

filter_reset.name: Filter reset
filter_reset.desc: No effect of its own (a placeholder, as in the original), but with ERST and LRST also off the step becomes a ghost trig. P-lockable.

filter_machine.name: Filter machine
filter_machine.desc: The filter type: CLASSC, MORPH, LADDER, COMB, FORMNT or SVF. Changes only while stopped.

filter_type.name: Filter type
filter_type.desc: CLASSC and SVF: low-pass, high-pass, band-pass or notch. P-lockable.

filter_cutoff.name: Filter cutoff
filter_cutoff.desc: Cutoff, 20 Hz to 20 kHz. On COMB (TUNE) the comb's pitch; on FORMNT it transposes the vowel formants. P-lockable.

filter_res.name: Filter resonance
filter_res.desc: Resonance, off to full. On COMB (FB) the comb's feedback. P-lockable.

filter_drive.name: Filter drive
filter_drive.desc: Saturation before the filter, off to full. On COMB (DAMP) a low-pass in the feedback, darker each echo. No drive on FORMNT. P-lockable.

filter_morph.name: Filter morph
filter_morph.desc: MORPH: sweeps low-pass (0) through notch (centre) to high-pass (128). On FORMNT (VOWL): the vowel, A-E-I-O-U. P-lockable.

filter_balance.name: Filter balance
filter_balance.desc: Spreads the two channels' cutoffs (L / R, or mid / side) up to +-24 semitones apart; 0 = both alike. P-lockable.

filter_mix.name: Filter mix
filter_mix.desc: Dry / wet blend, dry to fully filtered. Only COMB and FORMNT use it. P-lockable.

filter_mix_mode.name: Filter mix mode
filter_mix_mode.desc: How every filter machine splits the signal: STEREO (left / right) or M/S (mid / side), spread by BAL. Changes only while stopped.

filter_env_mode.name: Filter envelope mode
filter_env_mode.desc: ADSR (follows the note length) or AHR (attack, hold, release; ignores the note length).

filter_env_attack.name: Filter env attack
filter_env_attack.desc: The filter envelope's attack time, 0 up to the envelope range (AMP setup). P-lockable.

filter_env_decay.name: Filter env decay
filter_env_decay.desc: ADSR: the time to fall to the sustain level, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

filter_env_sustain.name: Filter env sustain
filter_env_sustain.desc: ADSR: the level held while the note lasts, 0 to full. P-lockable.

filter_env_release.name: Filter env release
filter_env_release.desc: The release time after the note ends (ADSR) or after the hold (AHR); the top of the knob is infinite. P-lockable.

filter_env_hold.name: Filter env hold
filter_env_hold.desc: AHR: how long the envelope holds at full; the top of the knob is infinite. P-lockable.

filter_env_depth.name: Filter env depth
filter_env_depth.desc: How far the filter envelope moves the cutoff, up to +-72 semitones; centre 0 = none, below opens downward. P-lockable.

env_mode.name: Amp envelope mode
env_mode.desc: ADSR (sustains while the note lasts) or AHR (attack, hold, release; ignores the note length). A setting, not p-lockable.

env_attack.name: Amp attack
env_attack.desc: The amp envelope's fade-in, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

env_decay.name: Amp decay
env_decay.desc: ADSR: the time to fall to the sustain level, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

env_sustain.name: Amp sustain
env_sustain.desc: ADSR: the level held while the note lasts, 0 to full. P-lockable.

env_release.name: Amp release
env_release.desc: The fade-out after the note ends (ADSR) or after the hold (AHR); the top is INF (no fade). P-lockable.

env_hold.name: Amp hold
env_hold.desc: AHR: how long the sound stays at full before releasing; the top is INF (holds until the next trig). P-lockable.

env_range.name: Envelope range
env_range.desc: The longest time the envelope knobs reach, 1 s to 1024 s (default 8 s). Applies to the amp, filter and mod envelopes.

fx_insert1_machine.name: FX machine
fx_insert1_machine.desc: The effect in this slot: the track's insert, or the S1 / S2 return or master insert. 18 machines; changes any time with a short fade.

fx_drive.name: Destroy drive
fx_drive.desc: DESTRY: the overdrive stage, off to full (0 bypasses it). P-lockable.

fx_mix.name: FX mix
fx_mix.desc: Dry / wet blend of the effect, dry to fully wet. P-lockable.

send_tap.name: Send tap
send_tap.desc: Where the sends take the track's signal: PRE (after the filter, before the insert) or POST (after the insert).

send1_level.name: Send 1 level
send1_level.desc: How much of the track goes to the S1 bus, off to full. P-lockable: throw single steps into the effect.

send2_level.name: Send 2 level
send2_level.desc: How much of the track goes to the S2 bus, off to full. P-lockable.

amp.name: Volume
amp.desc: The track's level, 0 to 127 (default 100), times the slot's gain. P-lockable.

pan.name: Pan
pan.desc: Stereo position, L64 to R64; C = centre. P-lockable.

lfo1_dest.name: LFO 1 destination
lfo1_dest.desc: What LFO 1 moves: OFF, PITCH (+-12 st), CUT, RES, AMP, PAN or a macro (M1-M4). Not p-lockable.

lfo1_wave.name: LFO 1 wave
lfo1_wave.desc: SINE, TRI, SAW, RSAW (ramp down), SQR or RAND (sample and hold). Not p-lockable.

lfo1_speed.name: LFO 1 speed
lfo1_speed.desc: One cycle per 8 bars down to 1/64, synced to the tempo. P-lockable.

lfo1_depth.name: LFO 1 depth
lfo1_depth.desc: How much LFO 1 moves its destination, -64 to +64; 0 = off, negative inverts. P-lockable.

lfo1_mode.name: LFO 1 mode
lfo1_mode.desc: FREE runs freely; TRIG restarts on steps with LRST on; ONE plays one cycle per trig then stops; HOLD latches its value at each trig.

lfo2_dest.name: LFO 2 destination
lfo2_dest.desc: What LFO 2 moves: OFF, PITCH (+-12 st), CUT, RES, AMP, PAN or a macro (M1-M4). Not p-lockable.

lfo2_wave.name: LFO 2 wave
lfo2_wave.desc: SINE, TRI, SAW, RSAW (ramp down), SQR or RAND (sample and hold). Not p-lockable.

lfo2_speed.name: LFO 2 speed
lfo2_speed.desc: One cycle per 8 bars down to 1/64, synced to the tempo. P-lockable.

lfo2_depth.name: LFO 2 depth
lfo2_depth.desc: How much LFO 2 moves its destination, -64 to +64; 0 = off, negative inverts. P-lockable.

lfo2_mode.name: LFO 2 mode
lfo2_mode.desc: FREE runs freely; TRIG restarts on steps with LRST on; ONE plays one cycle per trig then stops; HOLD latches its value at each trig.

portamento.name: Portamento (legato)
portamento.desc: ON: a trig that arrives while the amp envelope is still open extends the note instead of restarting the attack.

mode_switch_fade.name: Mode switch fade
mode_switch_fade.desc: Crossfade time when the warp mode's sound changes over, 1 to 250 ms.

loop_division.name: Loop key division
loop_division.desc: How many loop keys the region is divided into, 2 to 32 (even); above 16, SHIFT + key reaches 17-32.

trig_polyphony.name: Trig polyphony
trig_polyphony.desc: MONO: a new trig ends the previous note's p-locks and region lock. POLY: each note keeps its locks until it ends.

default_length.name: Note length
default_length.desc: How long a step's note lasts, 1/4 to 16 steps: the envelope gate, and how long its region and p-locks hold. P-lockable.

default_velocity.name: Velocity
default_velocity.desc: Trig velocity, 0 to 100%. Sets a slice's level and feeds the VELOCITY mod source (slice trigs only). P-lockable.

pattern_rate.name: Pattern rate
pattern_rate.desc: The track's step speed against the tempo, 1/16 to 2 (1 = sixteenth notes; 2 = twice as fast).

harm_interval.name: Harmony 1 interval
harm_interval.desc: HARM: the first harmony voice, -24 to +24 semitones; 0 = off. P-lockable.

harm_interval2.name: Harmony 2 interval
harm_interval2.desc: HARM: the second harmony voice, -24 to +24 semitones; 0 = off. P-lockable.

harm_interval3.name: Harmony 3 interval
harm_interval3.desc: HARM: the third harmony voice, -24 to +24 semitones; 0 = off. P-lockable.

wsola_window.name: OLA window
wsola_window.desc: OLA: the length of each grain, up to 500 ms (settings under 30 ms act as 30 ms). P-lockable.

wsola_search.name: OLA wander
wsola_search.desc: OLA: how far grains wander from the playhead, 0 to 100 ms (more with CHAOS). P-lockable.

pv_window.name: Pitch window
pv_window.desc: PITCH: the pitch shifter's window, 5 ms to 2 s (widened by SMEAR). Bigger = smoother, more smeared. P-lockable.

pv_dispersion.name: Pitch dispersion
pv_dispersion.desc: PITCH: random pitch scatter in the shifter, 0 to 100%. P-lockable.

wt_window.name: Wavetable size
wt_window.desc: WTBL: how many single-cycle waves are spread across the loop region, 2 to 64. P-lockable.

wt_cycle.name: Cycle width
wt_cycle.desc: WTBL: the length of each single cycle, 16 to 8192 samples (moves in semitone ratios). P-lockable.

wt_lfo_rate.name: Scan LFO rate
wt_lfo_rate.desc: WTBL: the speed of the built-in scan LFO, 0 to 8000 Hz (audio rates give FM / AM textures). P-lockable.

wt_lfo_depth.name: Scan LFO depth
wt_lfo_depth.desc: WTBL: how far the scan LFO moves MORF, -64 to +64; 0 = off. P-lockable.

wt_lfo_shape.name: Scan LFO shape
wt_lfo_shape.desc: WTBL: the scan LFO's wave - SINE, TRI, SAW, S&H or RAND. P-lockable.

freeze_amount.name: Freeze
freeze_amount.desc: FREEZE and FORMNT: captures and holds the spectrum at the playhead, 0 (live) to 100%. P-lockable.

spectral_blur.name: Spectral blur
spectral_blur.desc: FREEZE: smears the held spectrum, 0 to 100%. P-lockable.

formant_shift.name: Formant shift
formant_shift.desc: FORMNT: shifts the spectral envelope, -24 to +24 semitones; 0 = unchanged. P-lockable.

delay_time.name: Delay time
delay_time.desc: DELAY: the echo time, 1/32 to 2 bars incl. dotted and triplet, synced to the tempo. P-lockable.

delay_feedback.name: Feedback
delay_feedback.desc: DELAY, ECHO, T.ECHO: how much of each repeat feeds back, off to full. P-lockable.

delay_tone.name: Delay tone
delay_tone.desc: DELAY: low-pass on the repeats, 220 Hz to 18 kHz; full = brightest. P-lockable.

reverb_size.name: Reverb size
reverb_size.desc: REVERB and B.HOLE: the room size, small to huge. P-lockable.

reverb_damp.name: Reverb damping
reverb_damp.desc: REVERB: high-frequency damping, bright to dark. On B.HOLE (HI): the tail's high cut. P-lockable.

lofi_bits.name: Bit depth
lofi_bits.desc: LOFI: the output bit depth, 1 to 24 bits; lower = more crushed. P-lockable.

lofi_rate.name: Sample rate
lofi_rate.desc: LOFI: the output sample rate, 1 kHz to 48 kHz; lower = more aliasing. P-lockable.

comp_thresh.name: Threshold
comp_thresh.desc: COMP: the level above which it compresses, about -34 to 0 dB. P-lockable.

comp_ratio.name: Ratio
comp_ratio.desc: COMP: how hard it compresses, 1:1 to 20:1. P-lockable.

comp_attack.name: Comp attack
comp_attack.desc: COMP: how fast it clamps down, 0.5 to 100 ms. P-lockable.

comp_release.name: Comp release
comp_release.desc: COMP: how fast it lets go, 20 to 800 ms. P-lockable.

comp_makeup.name: Makeup gain
comp_makeup.desc: COMP: gain after compression, 0 to +12 dB. P-lockable.

destroy_warble.name: Warble
destroy_warble.desc: DESTRY: pitch wobble, off to fast and deep. P-lockable.

destroy_fold.name: Wavefold
destroy_fold.desc: DESTRY: wavefolding, off to heavy. P-lockable.

destroy_sat.name: Saturation
destroy_sat.desc: DESTRY: saturation, off to heavy. P-lockable.

destroy_crush.name: Bitcrush
destroy_crush.desc: DESTRY: bit reduction, off to 2 bits. P-lockable.

destroy_srr.name: Sample-rate reduction
destroy_srr.desc: DESTRY: sample-rate reduction, off to 500 Hz. P-lockable.

destroy_tone.name: Destroy tone
destroy_tone.desc: DESTRY: low-pass after the chain, 400 Hz to 18 kHz; full = brightest. P-lockable.

echo_time.name: Echo time
echo_time.desc: ECHO and T.ECHO: the echo time, 1/32 to 2 bars incl. dotted and triplet, synced to the tempo. P-lockable.

echo_offset.name: Echo offset
echo_offset.desc: ECHO: the right tap's time against the left, 0.5x to 2x; centre = equal. P-lockable.

echo_mode.name: Echo mode
echo_mode.desc: ECHO: STEREO or PING (ping-pong between the sides). P-lockable.

echo_tone.name: Echo tone
echo_tone.desc: ECHO and T.ECHO: low-pass on the repeats, dark to bright. P-lockable.

echo_wobble.name: Echo wobble
echo_wobble.desc: ECHO: wobble of the echo time, off to strong. P-lockable.

bh_gravity.name: Gravity
bh_gravity.desc: B.HOLE: the decay, short to infinite; at maximum the tail freezes. P-lockable.

bh_mod.name: Blackhole mod
bh_mod.desc: B.HOLE: modulation of the reverb, off to deep. P-lockable.

bh_low.name: Low cut
bh_low.desc: B.HOLE: high-pass on the tail, 20 Hz to 600 Hz. P-lockable.

bh_predelay.name: Pre-delay
bh_predelay.desc: B.HOLE: delay before the reverb, 0 to 200 ms. P-lockable.

modfx_rate.name: Mod rate
modfx_rate.desc: CHORUS, FLANGR, PHASER: the sweep speed, slow to fast (chorus about 0.05-8 Hz, flanger / phaser 0.02-4 Hz). P-lockable.

modfx_depth.name: Mod depth
modfx_depth.desc: CHORUS, FLANGR, PHASER: how deep the sweep goes, off to full. P-lockable.

modfx_tone.name: Mod tone
modfx_tone.desc: CHORUS, FLANGR, RINGS: low-pass on the wet signal, 400 Hz to 18 kHz. P-lockable.

chorus_width.name: Chorus width
chorus_width.desc: CHORUS: the phase offset between the left and right voices, mono to wide. P-lockable.

flanger_feedback.name: Flanger feedback
flanger_feedback.desc: FLANGR: bipolar feedback; centre = none, up = metallic, down = hollow (negative). P-lockable.

phaser_center.name: Phaser centre
phaser_center.desc: PHASER: the sweep's centre frequency, 100 Hz to 4 kHz. P-lockable.

phaser_stages.name: Phaser stages
phaser_stages.desc: PHASER: how many all-pass stages, 1 to 8 (more = more notches). P-lockable.

phaser_feedback.name: Phaser feedback
phaser_feedback.desc: PHASER: resonance, off to strong. P-lockable.

eq_low.name: EQ low
eq_low.desc: DJ EQ: the low band's gain; 0 = kill, centre = unity, top = boost. P-lockable.

eq_mid.name: EQ mid
eq_mid.desc: DJ EQ: the mid band's gain; 0 = kill, centre = unity, top = boost. P-lockable.

eq_high.name: EQ high
eq_high.desc: DJ EQ: the high band's gain; 0 = kill, centre = unity, top = boost. P-lockable.

eq_xlow.name: Low crossover
eq_xlow.desc: DJ EQ: where low meets mid, 80 to 500 Hz. P-lockable.

eq_xhi.name: High crossover
eq_xhi.desc: DJ EQ: where mid meets high, 1 to 8 kHz. P-lockable.

duck_amount.name: Duck amount
duck_amount.desc: DUCK: the most it turns the slot down, 0 to -40 dB. P-lockable.

duck_sens.name: Duck sensitivity
duck_sens.desc: DUCK: how strongly the program level drives the ducking, low to high. P-lockable.

duck_attack.name: Duck attack
duck_attack.desc: DUCK: how fast it ducks, 1 to 50 ms. P-lockable.

duck_release.name: Duck release
duck_release.desc: DUCK: how fast it comes back, 50 ms to 1.2 s. P-lockable.

tape_wow.name: Wow
tape_wow.desc: T.ECHO and CASSET: slow pitch wobble, off to strong. P-lockable.

tape_flutter.name: Flutter
tape_flutter.desc: T.ECHO and CASSET: fast pitch wobble, off to strong. P-lockable.

tape_sat.name: Tape saturation
tape_sat.desc: T.ECHO: saturation in the feedback loop, off to heavy. P-lockable.

cass_noise.name: Hiss
cass_noise.desc: CASSET: tape hiss, off to loud. P-lockable.

cass_crackle.name: Crackle
cass_crackle.desc: CASSET: crackle density, off to dense. P-lockable.

cass_drop.name: Dropouts
cass_drop.desc: CASSET: level dropouts, off to frequent and deep. P-lockable.

cass_tone.name: Cassette tone
cass_tone.desc: CASSET: low-pass, 1.2 kHz to 16 kHz; full = brightest. P-lockable.

motion_width.name: Stereo width
motion_width.desc: MOTION: 0 = mono, centre = unchanged, top = extra wide. P-lockable.

motion_rate.name: Motion rate
motion_rate.desc: MOTION: the tremolo / autopan speed, 1/32 to 4 bars, synced to the tempo. P-lockable.

motion_trem.name: Tremolo
motion_trem.desc: MOTION: tremolo depth (level), off to full. P-lockable.

motion_pan.name: Autopan
motion_pan.desc: MOTION: autopan depth (left / right), off to full. P-lockable.

motion_shape.name: Motion shape
motion_shape.desc: MOTION: the tremolo / autopan wave - SINE, TRI or SQR. P-lockable.

rings_mode.name: Rings mode
rings_mode.desc: RINGS: RING (ring modulation: bells, robots) or SHIFT (frequency shift: barber-pole smear). P-lockable.

rings_freq.name: Rings frequency
rings_freq.desc: RINGS: the modulator frequency, centre 0 out to about 2 kHz; the sign sets the shift direction in SHIFT. P-lockable.

rings_fine.name: Rings fine
rings_fine.desc: RINGS: fine offset of the frequency, +-20 Hz, for slow beating. P-lockable.

rings_feedback.name: Rings feedback
rings_feedback.desc: RINGS: feedback around the modulator, off to strong. P-lockable.

limit_gain.name: Limiter gain
limit_gain.desc: LIMIT: gain into the limiter, 0 to +18 dB. P-lockable.

limit_ceil.name: Ceiling
limit_ceil.desc: LIMIT: the highest output level, -12 to 0 dB. P-lockable.

limit_release.name: Limiter release
limit_release.desc: LIMIT: how fast the gain comes back, 2 to 100 ms. P-lockable.

menv_dest.name: Mod env destination
menv_dest.desc: What the mod envelope moves: OFF, PITCH, CUT, RES, AMP, PAN or a macro (M1-M4). Not p-lockable.

menv_attack.name: Mod env attack
menv_attack.desc: The mod envelope's attack, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

menv_decay.name: Mod env decay
menv_decay.desc: The time to fall to the sustain level, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

menv_sustain.name: Mod env sustain
menv_sustain.desc: The level held while the note lasts, 0 to full. P-lockable.

menv_release.name: Mod env release
menv_release.desc: The time to fall back after the note ends, 0 up to the envelope range. P-lockable.

menv_depth.name: Mod env depth
menv_depth.desc: How much the mod envelope moves its destination, -64 to +64; 0 = off. P-lockable.

mvel_dest.name: Velocity destination
mvel_dest.desc: What velocity moves: OFF, PITCH, CUT, RES, AMP, PAN or a macro (M1-M4). Velocity comes from slice trigs only. Not p-lockable.

mvel_depth.name: Velocity depth
mvel_depth.desc: How much velocity moves its destination, -64 to +64; 0 = off. P-lockable.

macro1_value.name: Macro 1
macro1_value.desc: Macro 1's value, 0 to 127; moves pitch, cutoff, res, amp and pan by its MACRO 1 depths. LFOs and envelopes can also drive it. P-lockable.

macro2_value.name: Macro 2
macro2_value.desc: Macro 2's value, 0 to 127; moves pitch, cutoff, res, amp and pan by its MACRO 2 depths. LFOs and envelopes can also drive it. P-lockable.

macro3_value.name: Macro 3
macro3_value.desc: Macro 3's value, 0 to 127; moves pitch, cutoff, res, amp and pan by its MACRO 3 depths. LFOs and envelopes can also drive it. P-lockable.

macro4_value.name: Macro 4
macro4_value.desc: Macro 4's value, 0 to 127; moves pitch, cutoff, res, amp and pan by its MACRO 4 depths. LFOs and envelopes can also drive it. P-lockable.

macro1_pitch_depth.name: Macro 1 to pitch
macro1_pitch_depth.desc: How far macro 1 moves pitch (up to +-12 semitones), -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro1_cutoff_depth.name: Macro 1 to cutoff
macro1_cutoff_depth.desc: How far macro 1 moves the filter cutoff, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro1_res_depth.name: Macro 1 to resonance
macro1_res_depth.desc: How far macro 1 moves the filter resonance, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro1_amp_depth.name: Macro 1 to amp
macro1_amp_depth.desc: How far macro 1 moves the track's level, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro1_pan_depth.name: Macro 1 to pan
macro1_pan_depth.desc: How far macro 1 moves the pan position, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro2_pitch_depth.name: Macro 2 to pitch
macro2_pitch_depth.desc: How far macro 2 moves pitch (up to +-12 semitones), -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro2_cutoff_depth.name: Macro 2 to cutoff
macro2_cutoff_depth.desc: How far macro 2 moves the filter cutoff, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro2_res_depth.name: Macro 2 to resonance
macro2_res_depth.desc: How far macro 2 moves the filter resonance, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro2_amp_depth.name: Macro 2 to amp
macro2_amp_depth.desc: How far macro 2 moves the track's level, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro2_pan_depth.name: Macro 2 to pan
macro2_pan_depth.desc: How far macro 2 moves the pan position, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro3_pitch_depth.name: Macro 3 to pitch
macro3_pitch_depth.desc: How far macro 3 moves pitch (up to +-12 semitones), -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro3_cutoff_depth.name: Macro 3 to cutoff
macro3_cutoff_depth.desc: How far macro 3 moves the filter cutoff, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro3_res_depth.name: Macro 3 to resonance
macro3_res_depth.desc: How far macro 3 moves the filter resonance, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro3_amp_depth.name: Macro 3 to amp
macro3_amp_depth.desc: How far macro 3 moves the track's level, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro3_pan_depth.name: Macro 3 to pan
macro3_pan_depth.desc: How far macro 3 moves the pan position, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro4_pitch_depth.name: Macro 4 to pitch
macro4_pitch_depth.desc: How far macro 4 moves pitch (up to +-12 semitones), -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro4_cutoff_depth.name: Macro 4 to cutoff
macro4_cutoff_depth.desc: How far macro 4 moves the filter cutoff, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro4_res_depth.name: Macro 4 to resonance
macro4_res_depth.desc: How far macro 4 moves the filter resonance, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro4_amp_depth.name: Macro 4 to amp
macro4_amp_depth.desc: How far macro 4 moves the track's level, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

macro4_pan_depth.name: Macro 4 to pan
macro4_pan_depth.desc: How far macro 4 moves the pan position, -64 to +64; 0 = not at all, negative inverts. Not p-lockable.

global.bpm.name: Tempo
global.bpm.desc: The project tempo, 20 to 300 BPM (SHIFT snaps to common tempos). Saved per pattern unless GBPM is on.

global.swing.name: Swing
global.swing.desc: Global swing, 50% (straight) to 75% (heavy): odd steps get longer, even ones shorter.

global.glen.name: Global length
global.glen.desc: The global pattern length, 1 to 256 steps: the boundary that SEQ pattern changes (and TEMP returns) wait for.

global.quant.name: Pattern change mode
global.quant.desc: How a picked pattern engages: SEQ (at the global length boundary), JUMP (now, same step), START (now, from step 1), TEMP (now, back after one pass).

global.rtn.name: Playhead return
global.rtn.desc: What the playhead does when loop keys are let go: RETURN (back in sync), BOOMR (plays back out in reverse) or RESET (restart).

slot.bpm.name: Sample BPM
slot.bpm.desc: The tempo the sample was played at, 20 to 300; changing it recalculates its length in steps. Tempo-fitting warp modes use it.

slot.steps.name: Sample steps
slot.steps.desc: How many sixteenth steps the trimmed sample spans, 1 to 512: the length tempo-fitting warp modes stretch it to.

slot.gain.name: Sample gain
slot.gain.desc: The slot's level, 0 to 4x, times each track's volume.

slot.trim_start.name: Trim start
slot.trim_start.desc: Where the sample starts, shown in seconds; everything (Range, loop, slices) lives inside the trim. SHIFT = finest step.

slot.trim_end.name: Trim end
slot.trim_end.desc: Where the sample ends, shown in seconds. SHIFT = finest step.

razor.start.name: Slice start
razor.start.desc: RAZOR: the selected slice's start, 0 to 1 of the track's window, moved under the SNAP mode.

razor.end.name: Slice end
razor.end.desc: RAZOR: the selected slice's end, 0 to 1 of the track's window, moved under the SNAP mode.

razor.play.name: Slice play mode
razor.play.desc: RAZOR: the selected slice's own play mode, or TRACK to use the track's.

razor.zoom.name: Zoom
razor.zoom.desc: RAZOR: zooms the waveform 1x to 64x, centred on the point last moved. View only.

razor.snap.name: Snap mode
razor.snap.desc: RAZOR: how STRT / END move - GRID (slice-count divisions), ZOOM (fine, by zoom), ZERO-X (zero crossings), TRANS (transients), FRIEND (drags the touching neighbour too).

razor.choke.name: Slice choke group
razor.choke.desc: RAZOR: the selected slice's choke group, A to H or OFF; a new voice in the group cuts the others.

razor.pitch.name: Slice pitch
razor.pitch.desc: RAZOR: the selected slice's pitch offset, -24 to +24 semitones.

razor.sens.name: Transient sensitivity
razor.sens.desc: RAZOR: sensitivity of the transient detection (the ticks) used by Auto-Chop and TRANS snap, 0 to 100.

e5.xfd.name: Scene crossfader
e5.xfd.desc: The A / B scene fader, 0 (scene A) to 128 (scene B); morphs every param stored in the scenes.

e5.choke.name: Slice choke group
e5.choke.desc: The choke group of the held pads (else the SLIC slice) in the pattern's slice program, NONE or 1 to 8; overrides the razor table's.

e5.gbpm.name: Global BPM
e5.gbpm.desc: ON: one tempo for every pattern. OFF: each pattern keeps its own BPM.

e5.name.name: Project name
e5.name.desc: Turn to name the project (OCT+ keeps it, OCT- cancels).

e5.mute.name: Slice mute
e5.mute.desc: Mutes the held pads (else the SLIC slice) in the pattern's slice program; muted slices stay on their steps but play nothing.
